name: print-social-supplement-social-ad-set-with-crayon-doodles-and-tape
title: Twelve kids-vitamin ads mixing emotional photos, crayon doodles, torn paper and product tubs
whatItIs: A 3x4 grid of square ads on crumpled paper. They combine photos of frustrated kids and teens with white fact panels and sticker badges, kid-drawn crayon diagrams and superheroes, torn green and blue paper strips, fruit and brain illustrations and product tubs on royal blue.
whatItMeans: Empathetic and playful; crayon doodles turn nutrition claims into child-friendly stories.
techniques: Mix emotional photos with childlike crayon drawings.
Use torn paper and tape strips as headline bars.
Put stat lines in white panels beside the photo.
Use royal blue as the anchor colour.
bestFor: Paid social ad sets with variety

vocabulary.definition: A drawing that imitates child crayon art.
A ragged paper band holding text.
A white block with a claim and checkmarks.
A photo showing a feeling that sparks attention.
